narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Folding thirds in half gives one fifth, because three and two make five.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Splitting a part in two does not add two parts. It turns every one part into two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We must count the pieces on the opened strip, not add the numbers.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, open the strip and count every part from one end to the other.
<bookmark mark='match'/>Then lay one part on each of the others, to see that all the parts are equal.
